contest: Most resources: whoever holds the most resources of any colors when the round ends (the board still prints the old "Most magenta").

story.line: Magenta steals resources and members (Cory, Oct 19: "Take any rival's member. Aggression is intentional").
story.greatGame: Round I: Help Yourself from whoever saved up, recruit Accomplice or Snitch. Round II: Second-Story Man and Heist on the follower leader; you hold resources because the contest counts all of them. Round III: Poach the best member on the table and steal at round end to take the +10 contest. Rivals spend down early, buy Bodyguards or Snitch, and use once-per-game members before you Poach them.
freshStart: Round I space: "Steal 3 resources in round I, 4 in round II, 5 in round III from one rival."
Round I space: "Steal 1 follower from each rival. +1 magenta."
Round II space: "Steal a rival’s member costing 7 or less. +1 magenta."
Round III space: "Recruit a rival’s member you choose, for free. +1 magenta."
Member: "Round End: before contests are scored, steal 2 resources from one rival."
Member: "Whenever you take a rival’s member, +2 followers."

cards.name: Help Yourself
cards.text: Steal 3 resources in round I, 4 in round II, 5 in round III from one rival.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, the leader is sitting on 9 saved for a 10-follower buy; I take 5, buy 10 followers next turn myself and they can only buy 5. A 10-follower swing between us, and they glare.
cards.topCase: Round III with Desperado and the Fence cloak: steal 7, +1 magenta, so 8 for me and 7 gone from one rival. Gather pays +4 red (+3 followers if you recruit). Strong, under twice the best space; doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: Take from one rival, more each round: the color in one line.
cards.ties: Pushes everyone to spend down before Magenta's turn, and swings the most-resources contest both ways at once.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 31: "maybe help yourself is enough" then "yes" (it's Magenta's fuel, Stash cut). Oct 29: "Help Yourself shouldnt give a magenta". Nov 5: "help yourself in heist" (swapped to one rival).
cards.why: Cory kept it as the color's fuel; the plainest steal and a real sting on the player saving up.
cards.short: Round III: steal 5 from the leader's saved 9, a 10-follower swing.

cards.name: Stash
cards.text: +2 magenta in round I, +3 in round II, +4 in round III. This turn, if you recruit a member, +1 follower in round I, +2 in round II, +3 in round III.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: +3 magenta, recruit Accomplice, +2 followers. Nobody notices.
cards.topCase: Round III: +4 magenta and +3 followers on a recruit, 7 in all; exactly Red's Gather and White's Allowance. Flat, never breaks.
cards.ideaWhy: A copy of Gather in magenta; nothing about stealing.
cards.ties: Touches nothing a rival owns; the same gain three colors print.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 31: Stash is cut ("maybe help yourself is enough", "yes"); stays live until he picks a replacement. Nov 5: Stash replacement kept in the backlog.
cards.why: Cory already cut it; it's another color's space in magenta.
cards.short: Round III: +4 magenta, and +3 followers if you recruit that turn.
cards.risk: Same card as Red's Gather and White's Allowance.

cards.name: Lie Low
cards.text: Steal 1 resource. Rivals can’t steal from you this round. +1 magenta.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I hold 10 to lead the most-resources contest and two thieves are still to place; I take Lie Low, steal 1, and their Help Yourself has to hit someone else.
cards.topCase: Round III, holding 12: it saves maybe 5 to 7 resources and the +10 contest. Its steal is 1. Strong only as a shield, and it piles every steal onto the unprotected players.
cards.ideaWhy: A tiny steal glued to a shield that lasts all round.
cards.ties: Moves every steal onto whoever isn't hiding, and blocks Poach for the round.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 27: "the steal block is so strong. it needs to be its own thing". Oct 31: "its hard to track". Nov 1: "I think b is ok"; with Bodyguards "this feels bad. We'll remember it."
cards.why: Breaks the space rule: its block lasts the whole round, and Cory said it's hard to track.
cards.short: Round III: holding 12, steal 1 and save 5 to 7 plus the contest.
cards.risk: Overlaps Bodyguards: the same shield, for one round.

cards.name: Heist
cards.text: Steal 3 followers, split among rivals as you choose. +1 magenta.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, the leader is 4 ahead of me; I take all 3 followers from them and the gap closes to -2. Straight to the score, and they feel it.
cards.topCase: Round III, every chance: 3 followers and 1 magenta, a 6-point swing against one rival. Promote or Initiation get a whole member. Fine, no break.
cards.ideaWhy: Take followers, the score itself.
cards.ties: Hits the follower leader directly, which also feeds Robin Hood and Snitch.
cards.coryNotes: Claude's rework, Nov 4 (under go-with-your-gut). Cory, Nov 5: "help yourself in heist" (Heist now splits among rivals).
cards.why: A real swing on the scoreboard, but the same "steal N" moment as Help Yourself one round later.
cards.short: Round II: take 3 followers from the leader, a 6-point swing.

cards.name: Shake Down
cards.text: Choose a rival. They choose one of their members costing 7 or less, then pay you its cost or you steal it. +1 magenta.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, a rival with 3 resources must hand over their 5-cost member or nothing; they give up their weakest, I get it.
cards.topCase: Round III: the rival offers their worst member at 7 or less; you gain a 1-follower member or up to 7 resources. Usually under Initiation. Flat.
cards.ideaWhy: Two rival choices and a price check on your turn.
cards.ties: Takes a member or resources from one rival, but the rival steers it to what they'd miss least.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 28 rework pick: "Shake Down victim chooses the member". Oct 18: on his redesign list.
cards.why: The rival picks twice on your turn, so you always get their worst; Heist beside it is a bigger moment.
cards.short: Round II: a rival hands over a member costing 7 or less, or pays.
cards.risk: Overlaps Poach, Kidnapper, Double Agent, Fixer: five take members.

cards.name: Poach
cards.text: Recruit a rival’s member you choose, for free. +1 magenta.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, the leader's Heist Crew (worth 4 followers, counts as 4) is the best card on the table; I take it. They drop 4, I gain 4, the whole table reacts.
cards.topCase: Round III, every chance: the best member anywhere, any cost, and the rival loses it, about twice Initiation's free member as a swing. Big, but one card and blocked by Bodyguards and Lie Low; doesn't break.
cards.ideaWhy: Take any rival's member.
cards.ties: Makes rivals hold Bodyguards or use once-per-game members early; shares the member pool with Red's swaps.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 19: "Lock Round III: Take any rival's member. Aggression is intentional". Nov 1: reads "for free".
cards.why: Cory locked it; the color's big round III moment.
cards.short: Round III: take the leader's Heist Crew, worth 4, free; they drop 4.
cards.risk: Overlaps Double Agent: a second way to take any member.

cards.name: Accomplice
cards.text: On Recruit: steal 3 resources.
cards.bestTurn: Round I, recruit it and take 3 from the player who just gathered; half its price back at once.
cards.topCase: With Desperado and Fence: steal 5 plus 1 magenta on a 5-cost member, once. Fine.
cards.ideaWhy: A small steal when it joins.
cards.ties: Feeds the most-resources contest and makes rivals regret holding.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 1: "I agree with price increase".
cards.why: Clean cheap opener; Shoplifter and Extortionist do the same job longer.
cards.short: Round I: recruit it and steal 3, half its price back.
cards.risk: Overlaps Shoplifter: both steal on recruiting.

cards.name: Second-Story Man
cards.text: Round End: before contests are scored, steal 2 resources from one rival.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I'm 1 behind the leader in most resources; at round end I take 2 from them and win +10 followers instead of them.
cards.topCase: Bought round I, with Desperado: steal 4 at each round end, 12 resources, and it can flip the round III contest worth 10. Strong, not broken.
cards.ideaWhy: A last-second steal that hits the contest.
cards.ties: The only card that aims a steal at the round-end contest; rivals must lead by more than 2.
cards.why: The best contest moment in the color, but it's Extortionist's repeating steal at the other end of the round.
cards.short: Round III end: steal 2 from the leader and flip the 10-follower contest.
cards.risk: Overlaps Extortionist: the same repeating steal 2.

cards.name: Desperado
cards.text: While you have the fewest followers (ties count), your steals take 2 more resources.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, I'm last; Help Yourself takes 6 instead of 4 and Accomplice 5 instead of 3. I'm back in it.
cards.topCase: Round III, last in followers with Shoplifter: 5 recruits steal 3 each, plus Help Yourself at 7: about 22 resources. Strong, near the edge.
cards.ideaWhy: Thieves who are behind steal more.
cards.ties: A catch-up card; ties count, so it switches on often in round I.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 1: "make it a flat, like +2 or +3"; built as +2 on any steal.
cards.why: Clean catch-up, but it only multiplies other cards and its top case with Shoplifter runs hot.
cards.short: Round III, last in followers: steals take 2 more, about 22 resources.
cards.risk: Near the edge with Shoplifter: about 22 resources a round.

cards.name: Robin Hood
cards.text: Whenever you steal from the player with the most followers, +1 follower.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I take Help Yourself from the leader: +5 resources and +1 follower, and Heist from them: another +1.
cards.topCase: Built around it: about 6 to 8 steals from the leader in a game, +6 to 8 followers for a 6-cost member. Fine.
cards.ideaWhy: Rob the rich.
cards.ties: Points every steal at the leader, a catch-up with no new rule.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 21: "absolutely shouldn't scale". Nov 5: he liked it too; out of the 10-card deck unless he says.
cards.why: Cory likes it; it aims Magenta at the leader in one plain line. Not in the 10-card deck.
cards.short: 6 to 8 steals from the leader a game: +6 to 8 followers.

cards.name: Extortionist
cards.text: On Recruit and at Round Start: steal 2 resources.
cards.bestTurn: Recruited round I: 2 now, 2 at round II start, 2 at round III start; the slow tax.
cards.topCase: Bought round I with Desperado: 4 each time, 12 resources for 9. Fine.
cards.ideaWhy: A steal that repeats each round.
cards.ties: Steady resource drain on rivals; same job as Second-Story Man.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 27: "Extortionist probably needs some work". Nov 5: "yes, but 'at Round Start'" on the short text.
cards.why: A near twin of Second-Story Man, which also hits the contest; the one you'd miss least.
cards.short: Bought round I: steal 2 now and at each round start, 6 total.
cards.risk: Overlaps Second-Story Man: the same repeating steal 2.

cards.name: Bodyguards
cards.text: Rivals can’t steal from you.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, the Magenta player goes for my saved 10; they can't touch me or my members.
cards.topCase: With two thieves at the table it saves 10 to 20 resources and stops Poach. Fine; with no thief it is 2 plain followers.
cards.ideaWhy: Thieves can't touch you.
cards.ties: Turns every steal onto the others; pairs with Lie Low to pile steals on one player.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 1: "this feels bad. We'll remember it." (with Lie Low). Nov 4: "Loyalists and bodyguards probably need to be reconciled. my gut is that stolen and swapped are different.... but idk".
cards.why: A needed counter, but it's an off switch, not a moment, and the same job as Lie Low.
cards.short: With two thieves at the table, it saves 10 to 20 resources.
cards.risk: Overlaps Lie Low: the same shield, all game.

cards.name: Heist Crew
cards.text: On Use, once per game: steal half of a rival's biggest pile, rounded down.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, a rival saved 10 white; I take 5 and they can't buy their 10 followers.
cards.topCase: Worth 4 followers alone plus one steal of about 3 to 5. Fine, and a Poach target.
cards.ideaWhy: One big grab at a hoard.
cards.ties: Punishes saving up; once per game for the card, so rivals may Poach it before you use it.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 5: "hoard breaker should be Big Score and it should be one time use"; "maybe Heist Crew". Nov 6: "make it worth like 4 members. but keep current price".
cards.why: Cory's pick, a good moment once a game; its size depends on rivals holding, which they rarely do.
cards.short: Round III: take 5 of a rival's 10 saved white, blocking their buy.

cards.name: Crew
cards.text: Worth 2 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round I, I buy it for the member count. Nobody notices.
cards.topCase: Always 2 followers for 5. Flat.
cards.ideaWhy: Filler with nothing of Magenta.
cards.ties: None beyond member count.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 21: keeps its text ("yes i think so"). Out of the 10-card deck.
cards.why: No moment and no theft; not in the 10-card deck.
cards.short: Always 2 followers for 5.

cards.name: Double Agent
cards.text: On Recruit: give this member to a rival and recruit one of theirs.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I pay 10, hand it over and take the leader's best member.
cards.topCase: Built around: 10 for any rival member, worth up to Poach on a member; the rival gets a blank card. Strong, a second Poach.
cards.ideaWhy: A swap, Red's verb, and a Poach you buy.
cards.ties: Takes from the member pool like Red's Promote and Demote; Bodyguards don't stop it.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 29: "can say 8 for now" (price). Nov 1: swaps read as a trade.
cards.why: It does Red's swapping and repeats Poach.
cards.short: Round III: pay 10, hand it over, take the leader's best member.
cards.risk: Overlaps Poach and Red's Promote: a second Poach, a swap.

cards.name: Fixer
cards.text: On Use, once per game: spend magenta equal to a rival’s member’s cost to steal it.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I've saved 7 magenta and take a rival's 7-cost member.
cards.topCase: Same as buying the member at full price, from a rival instead of the shop. Flat.
cards.ideaWhy: Cost math: a paid Poach.
cards.ties: Takes a member from a rival; rivals barely feel the price.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 25: "yes" to Claude's name and price. Out of the 10-card deck.
cards.why: Cost math and a weaker Poach; not in the 10-card deck.
cards.short: Round III: spend 7 saved magenta to take a rival's 7-cost member.
cards.risk: Overlaps Poach and Double Agent: another way to take members.

cards.name: Kidnapper
cards.text: On Recruit and at Round Start: steal a rival’s cheapest member.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, I recruit it and take a rival's 3-cost member; round III start I take another.
cards.topCase: Bought round II: 2 members over the game, each worth at least 1 follower plus its ability. Fine; the victim feels it twice.
cards.ideaWhy: Take a rival's member every round.
cards.ties: Thins rivals' cults; rewards rivals for not buying cheap filler.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 5: "yes, but 'at Round Start'" on the short text.
cards.why: A clean repeating member theft, but one of five Magenta cards that take members.
cards.short: Round II: take a rival's 3-cost member, then another at round III start.
cards.risk: Overlaps Poach and Shake Down: taking rivals' members.

cards.name: Snitch
cards.text: Whenever a rival steals from you, they lose 1 follower.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, two thieves hit me; each loses 1 follower for it.
cards.topCase: With two Magenta rivals: about 4 to 6 lost followers for them in a game. Fine.
cards.ideaWhy: Stealing from me costs you.
cards.ties: A counter that keeps steals open but taxed, unlike Bodyguards' off switch.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 21: "I like the counter". Nov 5: "i'd say snitch and big score".
cards.why: Cory likes it; a counter that keeps the fight going.
cards.short: Round II: two thieves hit you; each loses 1 follower.

cards.name: Shoplifter
cards.text: Whenever you recruit, steal 1 resource.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I buy followers or a member every turn; 5 steals of 1, and the contest leader keeps shrinking.
cards.topCase: Round III with Desperado: 5 recruits steal 3 each, 15 resources, plus 1 magenta each with the Fence cloak. Strong, not quite twice a round III space.
cards.ideaWhy: Every buy also takes from someone.
cards.ties: Ties Magenta to recruiting, so it fires on every turn.
cards.why: Cory's own idea; small drips, big only with Desperado.
cards.short: Round III with Desperado: 5 recruits steal 3 each, 15 resources.
cards.risk: Overlaps Accomplice: both steal on recruiting.

cards.name: Fence
cards.price: [3 magenta + 4 any, worth 1] (the Magenta cloak: picked at the start, not bought)
cards.text: Whenever you steal, +1 magenta.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, Help Yourself, Heist and Shoplifter each pay +1 magenta.
cards.topCase: About 9 magenta a game for its holder, under Cory's 10 to 12 target for cloaks. Fine.
cards.ideaWhy: Every steal pays a bit more.
cards.ties: Counts any of your steals, including Poach.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 6: "ok lets try. might be too good" (+2); "+1 probably too weak". Nov 7: "ok" (+1 live).
cards.why: The cloak works but runs just under the cloak target.
cards.short: Round III: Help Yourself, Heist and Shoplifter each pay +1 magenta.

overlaps: Extortionist "On Recruit and at Round Start: steal 2 resources." and Second-Story Man "Round End: before contests are scored, steal 2 resources from one rival.": the same repeating steal 2.

Five cards take members: Poach "Recruit a rival’s member you choose, for free. +1 magenta.", Shake Down "Choose a rival. They choose one of their members costing 7 or less, then pay you its cost or you steal it. +1 magenta.", Kidnapper "On Recruit and at Round Start: steal a rival’s cheapest member.", Double Agent "On Recruit: give this member to a rival and recruit one of theirs.", Fixer "On Use, once per game: spend magenta equal to a rival’s member’s cost to steal it."
Lie Low "Steal 1 resource. Rivals can’t steal from you this round. +1 magenta." and Bodyguards "Rivals can’t steal from you.": the same shield, one for a round.
Accomplice "On Recruit: steal 3 resources." and Shoplifter "Whenever you recruit, steal 1 resource.": both steal on recruiting.

Stash "+2 magenta in round I, +3 in round II, +4 in round III. This turn, if you recruit a member, +1 follower in round I, +2 in round II, +3 in round III." and Red's Gather "+2 red in round I, +3 in round II, +4 in round III. This turn, if you recruit a member, +1 follower in round I, +2 in round II, +3 in round III.": the same card.

Double Agent "On Recruit: give this member to a rival and recruit one of theirs." and Red's Promote "Swap any member with one in another cult or the shop costing up to 3 more. +3 red.": swapping is Red's.
notes: Round I is the weak spot: Help Yourself is the only clean space, Stash is already cut and Lie Low breaks the rule that a space does everything when taken. Too many cards take members (five) and too many guard against steals (Lie Low, Bodyguards, Snitch), while only Second-Story Man aims at Magenta's own most-resources contest. The round III payoff is Poach alone; Desperado with Shoplifter is the one pairing that runs hot. Crew, Robin Hood and Fixer are not in the 10-card deck.
storyShort: Magenta steals resources and members; most resources at round end wins the contest.
